name: Microgrid measurement stale-data supervisor
aliases: microgrids Microgrid supervisory and communication interfaces
summary: Marks the assigned power-system measurement invalid when its defined freshness condition is exceeded.
description: Marks the assigned power-system measurement invalid when its defined freshness condition is exceeded. Microgrid supervision coordinates measurements, control authority and resource communication without replacing local protection. Each resource value needs a named measurement boundary, freshness condition and intended control use.

In a microgrid control room, the operator can see source availability, active constraints and current operating mode. A communication failure should remain distinguishable from an electrical resource failure. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Measurement age and quality” at the input and “Stale-data indication” at the output. The permitted age depends on the control use.
